answer: Two leasing companies changed their third-party buyout rules on February 1, 2026. Crescent Motor Credit used to block third-party buyouts and has allowed them since February 1, 2026. Apex Lease Co already allowed them and still does, but since that date it adds a $350 third-party buyout fee to the buyout amount. Harbor Leasing, Summit Auto Lease, Bluewater Leasing and Ironwood Lease had no changes on that date.
